hypotheses.V0_exact_role_pair_recomposition: The 14 by 14 canonical-role pair expansion reconstructs the native Layer-0 bilinear gate and finite patch effect to at least 0.9999 fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.V1_pure_role_pair_program_is_compact: Discovery-ranked top-64 role-pair variations reach at least 0.90 held-out-template effect fidelity in every pure run.
hypotheses.V2_mixed_role_pair_program_is_broader: For every paired run, pure top-32 fidelity exceeds mixed-unselected top-32 fidelity by at least 0.05 on the held-out template.
hypotheses.V3_rule_relevant_value_routes_suffice_fo: Mean-filling variations involving rule-irrelevant entity digits retains at least 0.85 held-out-template fidelity in every pure run.
hypotheses.V4_arbitrary_facts_need_rule_irrelevant_: For every paired run, pure rule-relevant-only fidelity exceeds mixed-selected fidelity by at least 0.10 on the held-out template.
hypotheses.V5_arbitrary_load_globally_changes_value: For every paired run, pure rule-relevant-only fidelity exceeds mixed-unselected fidelity by at least 0.05 on the held-out template.
hypotheses.V6_cross_token_bilinear_terms_are_materi: Removing variation from pairs between distinct attention source tokens leaves below 0.90 fidelity for mixed selected facts in every run.
hypotheses.V7_weight_ranked_pairs_beat_random_pair_: Top-64 held-out-template fidelity exceeds the 95th percentile of twenty random 64-pair banks by at least 0.10 in every run and status.
hypotheses.V8_canonical_role_ranking_transfers_temp: Top-64 fidelity differs by at most 0.10 between trained and held-out templates in every run and status.
hypotheses.V9_signal_gate_passes: Every finite-effect cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
